scope: Independent static follow-up only; no active scientific outputs read, no helper main/audit/model/native execution.

recommendations_resolved.manifest_totals: Checks unique original paths, total file count and bytes; independently sums published file count/original bytes/stored bytes, omitted count and bytes. Printed verified count is len(published).
recommendations_resolved.checkpoint_omissions: Omitted path->bytes/hash mapping must equal postvalidation metadata from every passed case; all paths validated before omission. This links receipts but does not make checkpoint bytes public.
recommendations_resolved.measurement_recomputation: Frozen v4 validate_case applied to a deepcopy of each passed case; complete equality rejects any changed/recomputed field, including measurement.
recommendations_resolved.raw_membership: Curator performs final fresh recursive membership and hash/size map comparison with initial inventory, then rejects published .pt.
recommendations_resolved.paths: Earlier 22 negative and 3 valid path controls apply unchanged; drive/backslash/absolute/dotdot/noncanonical and resolved escapes rejected.

checkpoint_or_independent_quality_claims: Public output explicitly states checkpoint bytes unavailable, no independent quality reevaluation; execution_accepted and joint_screens_passed remain separate fields.
